# SeekerClaw

> SeekerClaw is the AI Agent Layer for the Solana Seeker phone. It turns the Seeker into an autonomous AI agent that monitors wallets, controls device functions, and connects via Telegram — all running 24/7 on-device.

SeekerClaw is a mobile application built specifically for the Solana Seeker phone (150K+ devices). It provides 18+ AI skills including wallet monitoring, DeFi automation, NFT tracking, Telegram notifications, and device control. The app runs autonomously on-device with user-held keys — no cloud custody. Open-source under the MIT License.

- Operating system: Android (Solana Seeker phone only)
- Wallet security: Hardware-secured via Seed Vault (private keys never leave the enclave)
- AI: Uses third-party LLM APIs (user provides their own API key, stored locally)
- Messaging: Telegram integration (user provides their own bot token)
- Privacy: No analytics, no tracking, no cloud servers, all data on-device
